title: GPU Utilization Constellation — daily rollup 2026-08-01
content:
Purpose: daily consolidated export used by capacity planners and on-call to spot region/pool anomalies. This is a working sheet (not final) — includes quick notes, raw rows exported from Grafana, and recommended next steps.

Summary observations (2026-08-01):
- Fleet average utilization: 57% (avg of weighted per-slot util across clusters).
- P90 token-serving latency probes stable; no SLO breaches.
- Notable: ORION-APAC-2 pool shows sustained 88% avg utilization with spikes to 96% between 09:30-11:00 UTC — correlates with customer ingestion batch (cust-47).
- NA pools have increased fragmentation: many small 1-slot reservations causing headroom loss in ALPHA-1 cluster.

Raw table (columns): Date | Region | Cluster | Pool | AvgUtil% | P90Util% | SlotsUsed | SlotsFree | ActiveJobs | PeakConcurrent | DeltaVsYesterday% | Notes
2026-08-01 | NA | alpha-1 | general-prod | 62 | 83 | 312 | 188 | 54 | 42 | +3 | fragmentation: 48 reservations <4 slots
2026-08-01 | NA | alpha-2 | compute-burst | 44 | 68 | 196 | 304 | 27 | 19 | -6 | underutilized during night window
2026-08-01 | EU | nebula-eu-1 | embeddings | 51 | 70 | 142 | 158 | 36 | 30 | +1 | normal
2026-08-01 | APAC | orion-apac-2 | realtime | 88 | 96 | 248 | 32 | 112 | 98 | +22 | correlated with cust-47 batch; queue depth rose 4x
2026-08-01 | NA | archive-us | cold | 14 | 25 | 28 | 372 | 3 | 2 | -1 | scheduled maintenance reduced capacity by 2 slots
2026-08-01 | EU | nebula-eu-2 | dedicated-enterprise | 73 | 90 | 312 | 88 | 61 | 51 | +5 | steady for committed customers

Derived metrics and quick calculations:
- Fleet headroom estimate (weighted): ~19% (conservative, assumes no preemption).
- Fragmentation loss estimate NA / alpha-1: ~8% effective capacity loss -> ~25 slots could be consolidated.
- Burst risk windows: APAC morning 09:00–12:00 UTC and NA evening 02:00–05:00 UTC.

Anomalies & correlation notes:
- ORION-APAC-2 spike: Grafana spike aligns with scheduled customer batch (cust-47 ingestion job). Customer notified and confirmed increased throughput on their side. Ticket created: INFRA-2378 (investigate autoscale tuning + pre-warming).
- ALPHA-1 fragmentation: multiple 1-2 slot reservations created by scheduled testing jobs from dev-team (ticket DEVOPS-903). Suggest enforcing minimum reservation size policy for test pools.
- Archive-us maintenance: node drain reduced cold pool slots; maintenance window ended 2026-08-01 18:00 UTC and capacity returned to normal after 23:00 UTC.

Recommendations (short term):
1) Immediate (P0/P1): pre-warm ORION-APAC-2 with 40 extra slots between 08:30–12:30 UTC for next 3 business days; owner: John R. (oncall) -> create autoscale rule INFRA-2378-01.
2) Short (within 72h): enforce reservation size policy in ALPHA pools: min 4 slots for test reservations; owner: Sofia Martinez; link: CONFLUENCE-5792/ops-playbooks.
3) Medium (1–2 weeks): run fragmentation consolidation job for alpha-1 to pack small reservations into fewer nodes during low-risk window; owner: Jamal Chen; RFC: RFC-4961.
4) Monitoring: add alert for pool-level sustained P90 util >85% for 30m with correlation to queue depth; owner: Evan Brooks.

Action log & tickets:
- INFRA-2378: ORION autoscale tuning (created 2026-08-01 by Maya P.) -> current status: triaged, awaiting capacity ops change.
- DEVOPS-903: dev-team test reservation surge -> contact dev leads (SLA exception requested).
- RFC-4961: fragmentation consolidation proposal (draft attached to CONFLUENCE-5792).

Quick checklist for on-call when alerted:
- Verify Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/cluster-util/constellation-daily (panel 4).
- Check active reservations list for pool -> consolidate if many <4 slots in NA alpha-1.
- Ping customer cust-47 contacts if spike persists beyond 3 windows.
- If autoscale fails to compensate in 10 minutes, escalate to infra-pager.

Notes for capacity planning meeting (2026-08-02):
- Consider temporary regional redistribution: move non-latency-sensitive embeddings workloads from nebula-eu-1 to alpha-2 for next 24 hours to free EU headroom for realtime spikes. Cost estimates: ~0.8% increase in cross-region egress for a 24h window.
- Consider adding a micro-queue priority for committed customers to reduce tail latency during microbursts.

Raw export provenance: generated from Grafana API (panel snapshot 2026-08-01 23:45 UTC) + manual annotations from on-call shifts.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Is there appetite to change default test reservation min across all clusters or only alpha pools? (tradeoff: developer convenience vs fragmentation).
- Should we expand pre-warm autopolicy to all APAC realtime pools or only ORION-APAC-2 as pilot?

Next steps (owner & due):
- John R. (oncall): implement pre-warm autoscale rule INFRA-2378-01 (due 2026-08-02 09:00 UTC).
- Sofia M.: draft policy change for reservation minima and circulate to dev leads (due 2026-08-04).
- Jamal C.: schedule fragmentation consolidation run and post results (due 2026-08-06).

Comment history:
- 2026-08-01 23:50 Maya P.: initial export and first-pass annotations.
- 2026-08-02 00:20 Evan B.: added alert rule suggestion.
- 2026-08-02 08:05 Sofia M.: confirmation on dev reservation behavior and noted ongoing RFC.

Bottom line: APAC realtime pool requires short-term capacity work (pre-warm/autoscale) and NA fragmentation requires policy and packing runs to recover ~8% effective capacity. This sheet is the working artifact for the capacity on-call and will be folded into CONFLUENCE-5792 after actions close.
